title: Trader Dale ORDER FLOW Trading Setups
author: Trader Dale

long_entries.rule: Volume cluster within trend (return to strong buy cluster)
Volume cluster within rejection (rejection of lower prices)
Multiple high-volume nodes at same level
Big buy limit order (25+ contracts in EUR futures scale)
Absorption at support (heavy volume, no downside continuation)
Aggressive buyers + delta turns positive at support
Cumulative delta divergence (price down, delta up)

short_entries.rule: Volume cluster within trend (return to strong sell cluster)
Volume cluster within rejection (rejection of higher prices)
Multiple high-volume nodes at same level
Aggressive sellers + delta turns negative at resistance
Cumulative delta divergence (price up, delta down)

exits.rule: Take profit just before heavy volume area
Stop behind heavy volume area (10-20% ATR)
Trail using 5m imbalances as long as on your side

synergies.TOF: Same order flow concepts, complementary setups
synergies.book_62: S/D zones align with volume clusters
